in_arabic.name: Nasikah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nasikah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic word 'nasiha', meaning to help, assist, advise, or support. In Islamic tradition, Nasikah symbolizes the virtue of being a helper and supporter, both in everyday life and in matters of faith.
